title: the guard denies a Bash segment that runs jitso build save however the shell reaches it: bare, bun run, the own path, after NAME=value words, after a separator, inside sh -c; the reason says only the owner saves a build
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and B3-19 (the agent boundary of build save is the launch guard)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7, B3-19). A session that could run `jitso build save` could approve its own draft, so the launch guard denies every Bash segment that runs it, in each form the guard already recognizes the launcher in: the word `jitso`, `bun run jitso`, this binary's own path, with `NAME=value` words before it, after `;` `&&` or a newline, and inside a quoted `sh -c`. The reason is `JITSO: only the owner saves a draft as a build; ask the owner to run: <launcher> build save <id> (denied: jitso build save)`.

values: bun run jitso build save x
cd a && jitso build save x

echo ok
jitso build save x

reason.regex: ^JITSO: only the owner saves a draft as a build; ask the owner to run: (bun run jitso|jitso) build save x \(denied: jitso build save\)$
